programs.title: Food Paradise: Food On Fire
programs.desc: From a chili pepper-topped pizza in Atlanta, to European-style porchetta flame-roasted on a food truck in San Francisco, Food Paradise goes coast to coast on the hunt for sweat-inducing fiery food.

programs.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programs.desc: "Chopped" judge Alex Guarnaschelli teams up with "Chopped Sweets" judge Elizabeth Chambers to give Bobby Flay some bittersweet memories  they recruit chefs Leanne Mascoli and Melanie Moss, who are sweet on walking away with a win.

programs.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programs.desc: Lela Loren, star of Power, pairs up with Bobby Flay's pal Michael Symon to try to get Bobby to power down in his own kitchen  chefs Lien Lin and Hamidullah Noori attempt to throw Bobby a curveball with a dish he's never heard of.

programs.title: Midnight Misadventures With Mallika Dua
programs.desc: Actress and dancer Sanya Malhotra and Shalishka take on the chopstick challenge and make Punjabi pie.
